headlines.description: NBC News is tracking confirmed measles case counts and state infection tallies. This data will be updated regularly.

headlines.title: A sixth measles-related death is reported in Pennsylvania
headlines.description: A county coroner announced the death. The state’s Health Department said it is “conducting a thorough review.”

headlines.title: What to know about Pope Leo’s lung surgery
headlines.description: Pope Leo XIV said he will have surgery this week to remove an early-stage nodule on his lung. The pontiff will be admitted to the hospital Tuesday.

headlines.title: MAHA fractures deepen as some RFK Jr. followers turn into harsh critics
headlines.description: A scorecard from MAHA activists suggests the Trump administration has broken most of its promises to the movement. The “burn feels especially raw,” one prominent activist said.

headlines.title: The secret to a good night’s rest? Let sleeping dogs lie — next to you
headlines.description: A surprising new study found that people who sleep near their dogs don’t experience disrupted sleep. If anything we humans are the ones disturbing our dogs’ sleep.

headlines.title: Pennsylvania health officials report a sixth measles-related death
headlines.description: Pennsylvania is at the center of the nation’s largest measles outbreak in three decades, with a sixth measles-related death reported as cases continue to surge. NBC News’ Erika Edwards shares the latest developments in the outbreak and what to know about vaccinations.

headlines.title: Terry Crews on Using His Platform to Advocate for Mental Health
headlines.description: Actor and mental health advocate Terry Crews and Project Healthy Minds founder and CEO Phil Schermer, join Saturday TODAY to discuss their flagship event on World Mental Health Day. Crews also shares how he uses his platform to encourage others to get the help they need and reflects on how mental health issues have been destigmatized over the years.

headlines.title: Changes to Make to Your Skin Care Routine for the Colder Months
headlines.description: After a long, hot summer, our skin may still be feeling the effects of the blistering sun long into the fall. Board-certified dermatologist Dr. Angela Lamb joins the 3rd Hour of TODAY to share tips on how to reverse the impacts of summer heat and keep your skin balanced and healthy going into a colder, dryer time of the year. Her advice includes loading up on Vitamin C, adding extra moisturizer to your daily skin care routine and never skipping SPF (even when the sun's not out!).

headlines.title: Tips for Taking Better Care of Your Mental Well-Being
headlines.description: As the year comes to an end and life gets busier, it can be difficult to keep a consistent routine and find time to take care of both your physical and mental health. Ben Meer, author of "How to Be Good at Life," joins the 3rd Hour of TODAY to share tips on how to create better habits that can reduce stress and improve your well-being.
